title: What is the administrator's email address of the chartered school with the
question: What is the administrator's email address of the chartered school with the fewest students enrolled in grades 1 through 12?

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT T2.AdmEmail1Local || '@' || T2.AdmEmail1Domain
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1
ORDER BY T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` ASC
LIMIT 1
